title: Nuluna - a European event illuminating the intersection of art, music, gaming with technology.

ms.promise: Confirmation of venue holding for the event dates, meeting all necessary requirements and staying within the allocated budget.
ms.criteria:
Acceptance Criteria:
・Identify and evaluate potential venues based on location, capacity, facilities, and budget.
・Select the preferred venue based on suitability and affordability.
・Confirm interest in venue with events manager or venue directly
ms.report:
We are pleased to share that our team has successfully confirmed a venue for the upcoming event, meeting all acceptance criteria and staying within the allocated budget.
Although this event was initially planned for Spring, it became difficult due to existing events that were planned around that time and we made some changes due to feedback from community on attendance and preferred time.
The date has been confirmed for the weekend of October 18th.
We are happy to add that the European Blockchain Convention will be happening the week leading up to our final chosen date - which we hope results in overspill as interest in our event, bringing more eyes to Cardano events. 
At the early stage of planning, we collaborated with an event organiser who supported our initial venue scouting and provided valuable input during the evaluation process. During a dedicated scouting trip to Barcelona, we reviewed a number of potential venues and narrowed our shortlist down to a few strong candidates.
After thorough consideration of each venue’s location, capacity, facilities, availability, and alignment with our event goals, we selected the final venue.
The decision was made collaboratively and reflects both logistical fit as well as meeting our initial budget plans. 
See here for event venue searching and scouting with event planner.
See here for additional potential venue which was visited in person.
See here for invoice paid to secure booking with final venue.
See here for our own videos from in person site visit and meeting with venue manager. 
Many thanks, and I hope you will be free to attend :D
